content.short: Uniswap v4 DEX whose liquidity changes shape and moves on its own as markets shift.
content.description: Bunni lets liquidity providers program how their liquidity is spread across prices and when it should move, so a stablecoin position can, for example, shift away from the peg to buy a depeg. Idle liquidity is lent out on platforms such as Aave and Gearbox for extra yield, while an auction-managed AMM and surge fees reduce losses to MEV and arbitrage. The app was hit by a security exploit on 2 September 2025, and the team has published its analysis.
content.meta: Bunni's shapeshifting liquidity on Uniswap v4 moves with the market, lends idle funds and uses surge fees to cut LP losses.
